log_title: 6b. Storage face: 2-drive switchless S2X replaces SM-1 in the first build (done 2026-10-08)
log_md:
The 4-drive ASM2824 board (SM-1) is **parked** (Aidan, 2026-10-04 22:12 / 2026-10-08); the first build now uses `kicad/macpro62-storage-face-2x` (S2X rev A0: 2 x M.2 2280 straight from J1 lanes 0-3 / 4-7, no switch). Routed 2026-10-08: DRC 0 / 0 unconnected / parity 0, ERC 0. Per-order change, q1 (2 boards) / q5 (5 boards):

| # | Change | SM-1 | S2X | Saving q1 / q5 | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Stackup 6L JLC06161H-2116 → **4L JLC04161H-7628** | fab $60–90 | $30–55 | $30–35 / $30–35 | done, DRC 0 |
| 2 | PCBA double-sided Standard with BGA X-ray → **Economic, single-sided** (all parts on B) | $175–230 / $200–265 | $25–45 / $30–55 | $150–185 / $170–210 | done; Economic must accept the MCIO124 (global-sourced / consigned) |
| 3 | No ASM2824 switch, no gap pad for it; TPS259470 eFuse (replaces LM74700 + FET + TPS259824); 2 x TPS54331 bucks; INA238 (INA228 C2887910 has 0 stock) | $95–200 / $235–470 | $55–80 / $135–185 | $40–120 / $100–285 | done |
| 4 | Gap pads: 1 x ASM2824 pad → 2 x M.2 2280 pads (optional) | $5–15 / $15–40 | $8–20 / $20–50 | −$3–5 / −$5–10 | optional |

S2X board: **q1 $335–535 → $118–200**; **q5 $510–865 → $215–345**.
Cost option (needs approval): INA238 → INA226 C49851 ($0.76) saves ≈ $7.5/board (≈ $15 q1 / $38 q5); firmware register map differs.
Host-side changes for slot B (CPU PEG 2 x 8 bifurcation, REFCLK1/PERST1# on the BP) are listed in `kicad/macpro62-storage-face-2x/docs/ICD_CHANGES.md`; with BP rev A only slot A works.
